assumptions: The start and stop codons are the chosen code's; a circular molecule's frames wrap the origin.
limits: An ORF is a reading frame, not a gene: no promoter, RBS or expression evidence is involved.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which open reading frames does this molecule carry, on both strands?

description: Find open reading frames on BOTH strands of the subject (origin-spanning when circular).

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

alternative_starts.description: also accept GTG/CTG as start codons (not just ATG).

name: find_orfs

longest.description: length of the longest ORF in bp
